svg.title: Which stage to inspect
svg.desc: General guidance for any formula and trace. Work down five questions. Does the formula document read back as the requirement; is every proposition bound to the intended signal; does the rewritten formula give the original verdict; do tl-mltl and tl-oracle return the same verdict; does the monitor verdict match tl-mltl. The first answer of no points at the stage to inspect: text or parse, binding, rewrite, evaluator, or monitor mapping. If every answer is yes, the verdict stands for this input and the requirement or the recorded trace is what to re-read.

g.data-text: Does the formula document read back as the requirement?: compare the tl-parse canonical text with the requirement
Every stage agrees: the verdict is correct for this input; re-read the requirement and the recorded trace
Do tl-mltl and tl-oracle return the same verdict?: evaluate the same formula and trace in both
Is every proposition bound to the intended signal?: read the bindings in the tl-syntax signal catalog
Does the rewritten formula give the original verdict?: tl-rewrite equivalence check on the same trace
Does the monitor verdict match tl-mltl?: compare_external classifies the pair
Monitor mapping: the C2PO expression or the monitor run
Text or parse: tl-parse diagnostics and the document
Evaluator: tl-mltl or tl-oracle; shrink the trace
Binding: the catalog or the proposition map
Rewrite: the rule named in the tl-rewrite report
